examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the home page places it: two customer stories in the framed grid, the first one spanning two columns and two rows, followed by six client marks on mixed fills. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no stories and no logos renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Ordered cells
examples.summary: `cells` places story and mark tiles in one ordered list, each with its own `span` and `rows`, as the home page does: Netshoes leads two by two, three marks follow, GPA runs two rows tall with its stacked lockup one step taller, and the marks on `white` and `primary` fills take the knockout ink. `anchor` makes the band a `#clients` target.
